I used the animal_pose_auditor's low-confidence keypoints (specifically in hind limbs/ankles) to corroborate my observation of hoof/grass fusion issues. I utilized the fine_grained_classifier results to confirm object identity.

6. Atom Score Review: All atom scores are justified by direct visual evidence and supported by expert classifiers. Tax scores are 1.0 as taxonomy info was available and relevant.

7. Upward Override Justification: No upward overrides were necessary; my assessment remained consistent with or more detailed than the preliminary evaluation. I maintained strict adherence to visual evidence for all positive verdicts.

Final scores remain unchanged as they accurately reflect the image quality and adherence to the prompt after critical review.
